'''Zsajhira berry juice''' was produced from the [[Zsajhira berry|Zsajhira]] fruit. It was used as a glaze in cooking; the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Feyodor]] glazed stuffed [[Uln]] [[Bird/Legends|birds]] with a light mist of Zsajhira berry juice.<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref>
